name: Genesis
english_description: The official mudlib of Genesis, one of the oldest and most influential LPMuds still running. This is the engine only (master, login, std/ base classes, command souls, board/mail/bank/donation/report subsystems, the full wizard toolset) -- per the repo's own README, it ships no /d/Genesis game-world domain at all (no rooms, no NPCs, no items, no race content). Porting it surfaced two especially wide-reaching FluffOS-compat bugs: add_action() with a bare function value (used at 151 of 158 call sites, including the soul-command dispatch entry point) compiles but is never matched against typed input on this driver, and this codebase's own CD-driver-style uid/euid simulation had setuid()/seteuid() silently corrupting every object's owner uid via an unresolvable placeholder string. A from-scratch character-creation bootstrap and a bare landing room were added since no domain ships to place new characters in.
